mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.2%) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as the cost of capital remains suppressed.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.5% signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.5%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
candidate_trigger: both HOUST and RSAFS above 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220) triggers expectations of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as rate hikes compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 220, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth exceeding 100,000 jobs per month signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs per month, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in retail sales and housing starts above their 6-month moving averages indicate sustained consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: both RSAFS and HOUST above 6-month moving averages
failure_condition: When both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 6-month moving averages, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Weak retail sales growth below 0.5% per month indicates slowing consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: When RSAFS growth is below 0.5% per month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such months.
